text:
anya: Quick sync  draft RN for v1.24.1 is ready: https://redwood.docs/rn/v1.24.1. Need a tiny ops section + internal blurb.
kevin: scanning. please add a one-line impact summary and an explicit rollback command. ops prefers exact commands to avoid ambiguity.
maria: FYI we learned from the last migration to keep step-by-step steps and a safety flag. add migration-id and DB snapshot tag.
anya: added migration id: mig-20260320-42 and snapshot tag: snap-pre-v1.24.1. Also added quick rollback commands. excerpt: ```bash
# rollback to last stable
redwoodctl deploy set-version --service web-api --version v1.24.0
redwoodctl db restore --tag snap-pre-v1.24.1
redwoodctl feature disable hot_new_runner
```
sam: I'll be the named ops lead for the window (04:00 UTC). please put my pager number and slack contact in RN. I'll have db-admin on standby.
nick: put a blunt trigger in the checklist: if p95 latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive 2-minute intervals -> rollback. Also watch model-token-outliers.
\eke: (kevin): slight reword on intro: "maintenance & perf improvements; no expected user-visible behavior change." keep customer comms hold until post-canary.
maria: please ensure internal blurb tells PMs not to push customer comms until ops confirm. add a PM contact line.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @anya for 2026-04-05 04:00:00 UTC to cluster-prod-02. Canary: 20m with gradual ramp (0.5% -> 5% -> 20%). Health endpoints: /health, /metrics/token_rate. Canary thresholds: error-rate < 1% and p95 latency < 200ms.
anya: added internal blurb block: "Deploying v1.24.1 (infra perf & migration). No customer-visible changes expected. Ops standby 04:00 UTC. If canary exceeds thresholds, rollback to v1.24.0." can someone sign off on wording?
sam: good. Also add a short 'what to say' line for the internal announcement to #general and #product: one-sentence + ops contact. example: "Rolling out v1.24.1 for infra perf; monitoring now; ops standby 04:00 UTC. Contact @sam for issues."
kevin: LGTM. One more: pin the RN at top of the channel and add a clear last-updated line with deploy-bot ID.
maria: minor nit: include a customer-facing FAQ snippet in a hidden section in case comms needed quickly. just 2 bullets.
anya: done. pinned RN header: "v1.24.1 deploy + ops checklist" and added a 'postmortem owners' line.
deploy-bot: Reminder: will post "deploy starting (canary ramping)" to #eng-releases at 2026-04-05 03:40:00 UTC. Ensure pin is set before that time.
kevin: I'll schedule the internal announcement 30m prior to deploy in #general and DM platform leads. @anya confirm the exact text and I'll post.
anya: copied the one-line blurb into RN and into a draft message for #general. If there are no objections in 15m I'll publish and pin. :thumbsup: 
kevin: no objections from me. publishing in 10.
sam: I'll set alerting to page at a lower threshold for the first 45m and watch KV cache hit ratio.
maria: good. Also note: if rollback happens, we'll open an incident in incidents channel and tag postmortem owners.
anya: publishing the internal announce now + pinning RN. thanks team.
deploy-bot: Announcement posted to #eng-releases and pin applied (deploy-id dbd-707001).
